description: Generic Intel ACPI capability profile. It identifies hosts whose ACPI topology can be evaluated by a later macOS-side validation stage without inventing SSDTs or patches.

requiredEvidence: Only validated SSDT additions or ACPI patches
prohibitedAutomation: Do not generate ACPI patches from Windows PnP names.
Do not infer SSDT contents from Windows device identifiers.
Do not inject DSDT/SSDT files unless a validated profile explicitly supplies them.
